mapper.sql: d.id, d.application_id, d.post_id, d.student_id, d.work_month, d.work_date, d.hours, d.content, d.over_limit, d.status, d.recorder_id, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted, p.name AS post_name, p.unit AS unit, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name

FROM workstudy_timesheet d LEFT JOIN workstudy_post p ON p.id = d.post_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = d.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = d.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workstudy_timesheet (application_id, post_id, student_id, work_month, work_date, hours, content, over_limit, status, recorder_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{postId}, #{studentId}, #{workMonth}, #{workDate}, #{hours}, #{content}, #{overLimit}, #{status}, #{recorderId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE workstudy_timesheet SET status = #{toStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT d.status AS status, COALESCE(SUM(d.hours), 0) AS hours FROM workstudy_timesheet d LEFT JOIN workstudy_post p ON p.id = d.post_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.work_month = #{workMonth} AND p.unit_user_id = #{unitUserId} GROUP BY d.status

SELECT d.student_id AS student_id, d.post_id AS post_id, MAX(d.application_id) AS application_id, COALESCE(SUM(d.hours), 0) AS hours FROM workstudy_timesheet d WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 'confirmed' AND d.work_month = #{workMonth} GROUP BY d.student_id, d.post_id
